mapper.select: SELECT jm.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS mIdx, cu.COMPANY_NAME AS cName, jp.TITLE AS jobPos, IFNULL(jm.JOB_MATCH_SCORE, 0) AS mRate, DATE(jm.MATCHING_CREATEAT) AS mDate, IFNULL(ja.STATUS, '확인완료') AS mStatus FROM jobseeker_matching jm JOIN company_users cu ON cu.COMPANY_IDX = jm.COMPANY_IDX JOIN job_posts jp ON jp.JOB_POSTS_IDX = jm.JOB_POSTS_IDX LEFT JOIN jobseeker_applicant ja ON ja.JOBSEEKER_IDX = jm.JOBSEEKER_IDX AND ja.COMPANY_IDX = jm.COMPANY_IDX AND ja.JOB_POSTS_IDX = jm.JOB_POSTS_IDX WHERE jm.JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobseekerIdx} ORDER BY jm.MATCHING_CREATEAT DESC LIMIT 20
